author: ABMN Staff
title: Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for December, 27th (AAOG, AAPL, ACER, AIR, AMZN, ASH, DHER, ESTE, FPM, GOOG)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Dec 27th, 2018 // No Comments
Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Thursday, December 27th:
Namibian Resources (LON:AAOG) had its corporate rating reissued by analysts at FinnCap. Get Namibian Resources Plc alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co..
Acer Therapeutics (NASDAQ:ACER) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at HC Wainwright. They currently have a $55.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Valuation methodology, risks, and uncertainties. We value Acer using a composite risk-adjusted net present value (rNPV) approach, which employs a 15% discount rate and 30% effective tax rate across all future cash flows, while ascribing an 85% probability of success to EDSIVO and a 60% and 50% probability of success to MSUD, respectively. This yields a total rNPV of $600M, with $350M coming from EDSIVO and $250M from ACER-001. Assuming approximately 11M fully-diluted shares outstanding as of mid-2019, this translates into a price objective of $55.00 per share.””
Airbus (EPA:AIR) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Barclays PLC.
Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada.
Ashland Global (NYSE:ASH) was upgraded by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co. from a neutral rating to an overweight rating.
Delivery Hero (ETR:DHER) was given a €50.00 ($58.14) price target by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Earthstone Energy (NYSE:ESTE) had its outperform rating reiterated by analysts at Imperial Capital. Imperial Capital currently has a $8.00 price target on the stock, down from their previous price target of $12.00.
Faroe Petroleum (LON:FPM) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Peel Hunt.
Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada.
Halcon Resources (NYSE:HK) had its outperform rating reissued by analysts at Imperial Capital. The firm currently has a $3.00 price target on the stock, down from their previous price target of $6.00.
Infineon Technologies (ETR:IFXA) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at DZ Bank AG.
Kala Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:KALA) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. The analysts wrote, “Our 12-month price target is derived from a market value of the firm at $495M, which includes a discounted cash flow-based asset value of $570M for INVELTYS (100% probability of success) and KPI-121 0.25% (65% probability of success), with a 15% discount rate and 0.5% terminal growth rate, excluding $75M debt.””
Key Energy Services (NYSE:KEG) had its price target lowered by Simmons from $45.00 to $3.25. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Michaels Companies (NASDAQ:MIK) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Loop Capital. They noted that the move was a valuation call. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call.
Pattern Energy Group (NASDAQ:PEGI) (TSE:PEG) was upgraded by analysts at Bank of America Corp from an underperform rating to a neutral rating.
Pioneer Energy Services (NYSE:PES) had its target price reduced by Simmons from $45.00 to $2.25. They currently have an overweight rating on the stock.
Plus500 (LON:PLUS) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Liberum Capital.
Citigroup Inc began coverage on shares of Ship Finance International (NYSE:SFL) . They issued a neutral rating on the stock.
Schaeffler (FRA:SHA) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at DZ Bank AG.
